privacy.title: Privacy: how we use your information
privacy.intro: KaziForce follows Kenya’s Data Protection Act, 2019. This page says, in plain words, what we keep about you, why, who else sees it, for how long, and what you can do about it.

who.heading: Who we are
who.body: KaziForce connects people looking for short-term work with employers in Kenya. This version is a student project at Strathmore University, Nairobi.

collect.heading: What we keep
items: Your account: name, email address, password (stored scrambled, never readable), your side (worker or employer), language, area, skills or company name.
Your phone number, only if you give it, and whether you agreed to SMS and WhatsApp alerts.
What you do on KaziForce: jobs you post or apply for, your messages, and your alert settings.
Your alerts, and when each one was sent, delivered, opened or marked “Not important to me”.
For safety: the phones and computers you log in from, so we can ask for a code on a new one.

why.heading: Why we keep it
items: To run your account and show you jobs, applications and messages.
To send each alert the right way: urgent ones fast (WhatsApp or SMS if you allowed it), the rest by email or in your summary.
To keep your account safe and stop scams.
To make the alert sorting better. For this we use copies of alerts with names, phone numbers and email addresses removed. They cannot be traced back to you.

share.heading: Who else sees it
share.intro: Only the services we need to send your alerts and run the site:
items: Twilio (WhatsApp) and Africa’s Talking (SMS): your phone number and a short summary with a link. Never your personal details.
Resend (email): your email address and the email we send you.
Your browser’s pop-up service (Google, Mozilla or Apple), if you turn pop-ups on: a one-line summary only.
Supabase (database), Microsoft Azure (server) and Vercel (website): they store and run KaziForce for us.
share.never: We never sell your information and never use it for advertising.

abroad.heading: Where it is stored
abroad.body: Our database is in Frankfurt (Germany) and our server in Spain, both in the European Union, which has strong data protection laws. Sending alerts may pass through the providers’ systems in other countries.

keep.heading: How long we keep it
items: Your account: until you delete it. After you ask, it is deleted within 14 days (you can change your mind until then).
Your alerts: 12 months, then they are deleted.
Records of how alerts were delivered: 180 days.
Log-in codes and password reset links: they stop working within an hour and are removed the next day.
Alerts you sent to other people stay in their history, but your name is replaced with “a former user” and your chat words are removed.

rights.heading: Your rights
items: See and correct your details: Settings → Your profile.
Choose what reaches you, and how: Alert settings. Reply STOP (or ACHA) to any SMS or WhatsApp to stop that channel.
Delete your account and your information: Settings → Delete my account.
Get a copy of what we keep about you: Settings → Download my data. To object to how we use it: contact us (below).
If you are not happy with our answer, you can complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC), www.odpc.go.ke.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.withEmail: Questions about your information: write to {{email}}. We answer within 7 days.
contact.withoutEmail: Questions about your information: send a message to the KaziForce team from your account, or ask an administrator. We answer within 7 days.
